cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I tell you who won, which candidate were you hoping for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write my choice and turn the paper face down. You won't have to look at me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep my paper face down. Show me your candidate's name, then you can turn mine over.
